row.description: An applicant must clearly state in its application that it shall meet the licensee deposit requirement.

citations.excerpt: PML Section 1316 (as incorporated by PML Section 1321-f) provides for the following minimum license thresholds: No applicant shall be eligible to receive a gaming license unless the applicant meets the following criteria and clearly states as part of an application that the applicant shall:
3. meet the licensee deposit requirement;

reason: The cited text expressly states that no applicant is eligible unless it clearly states in the application that it shall 'meet the licensee deposit requirement.' This supports both the actor and the obligation.

row.description: An applicant must clearly state in its application how it proposes to address problem gambling concerns, workforce development, community development, and host and nearby municipality impact and mitigation issues.

reason: The cited text expressly requires the applicant to clearly state in the application that it will demonstrate how it proposes to address problem gambling, workforce development, community development, and host/nearby municipality impacts and mitigation. The candidate is supported.
